sentences.en: He is reputable, intelligent, and above all, good looking.
sentences.zh: 他不仅聪明，而且长相英俊，更重要的是名声很好。

sentences.en: She is reputable, rational and above all pretty.
sentences.zh: 她不仅理性，还非常漂亮，总之很有名望。

sentences.en: People were shocked when he cited a supermarket tabloid as a reputable newspaper.
sentences.zh: 当他引用一家超市小报作为可靠报纸时，人们感到震惊。
